evals.prompt: 帮我监控腾讯音乐最近有什么新事件，分析一下对公司的影响
evals.expected_output: Creates tencent-music/ directory structure with analyzed_events.json, index.md, and at least one event file in events/. Each event file should follow the bilingual template with summary, direct impact, strategic implications, investor angle, and risk/opportunity sections.

assertions.name: directory_structure_created
assertions.description: tencent-music/ directory exists with index.md, analyzed_events.json, and events/ subdirectory

assertions.name: at_least_one_event_file
assertions.description: At least one .md file exists inside tencent-music/events/

assertions.name: event_file_bilingual_headers
assertions.description: Event files contain all 5 bilingual section headers: 事件摘要/Summary, 直接影响/Direct Impact, 战略意义/Strategic Implications, 投资者视角/Investor Angle, 风险与机遇/Risk & Opportunity

assertions.name: analyzed_events_json_valid
assertions.description: analyzed_events.json is valid JSON with an 'events' array containing at least one entry with url, title, date, file, and impact_rating fields

assertions.name: index_md_has_table_row
assertions.description: index.md contains at least one data row in the event table (not just the header)

evals.prompt: Search for recent TME news and analyze the business impact. Store results as usual.
evals.expected_output: Performs web searches for Tencent Music using multiple queries, deduplicates against existing registry, writes structured impact analysis files with correct bilingual format, updates index.md table, and reports summary to user.

assertions.description: tencent-music/ directory exists with index.md, analyzed_events.json, and events/ subdirectory

assertions.name: tme_nyse_mentioned_in_investor_angle

evals.prompt: 腾讯音乐今年的订阅用户增长情况怎么样？帮我找找最新财报或者相关新闻，按照标准格式分析保存
